name: Analyze document
description: Analyze a supported document attachment using a model's native file input.

function.name: analyze_document
function.description: Analyze a user-sent PDF, text/code file, office document, presentation, or spreadsheet with a compatible provider-native document model. Use the numeric id from the attachment metadata. The file is not parsed locally and its contents are treated as untrusted data.

attachment_id.description: Numeric Attachment ID shown with the user-uploaded document.

query.description: Optional question or analysis instruction. If omitted, returns a structured summary including important visual information.
